label: Namsor
description: Parse, classify, transliterate and match names, process batches and manage key privacy settings

operations.name: get_api_key_info
operations.description: Read API Key info.

operations.name: get_api_usage
operations.description: Print current API usage.

operations.name: classify_name_type
operations.description: Infer the likely type of a proper noun (personal name, brand name, place name etc.)

operations.name: classify_gender
operations.description: Infer the likely gender of a name.

operations.name: classify_gender_geo
operations.description: Infer the likely gender of a name, given a local context (ISO2 country code).

operations.name: classify_gender_full
operations.description: Infer the likely gender of a full name, ex. John H. Smith

operations.name: classify_gender_full_geo
operations.description: Infer the likely gender of a full name, given a local context (ISO2 country code).

operations.name: parse_name
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. John Smith or SMITH, John or SMITH; John.

operations.name: parse_name_geo
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. John Smith or SMITH, John or SMITH; John. For better accuracy, provide a geographic context.

operations.name: parse_chinese_name
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. 王晓明 -> 王(surname) 晓明(given name)

operations.name: romanize_chinese_name
operations.description: Romanize the Chinese name to Pinyin, ex. 王晓明 -> Wang (surname) Xiaoming (given name)

operations.name: match_chinese_name
operations.description: Return a score for matching Chinese name ex. 王晓明 with a romanized name ex. Wang Xiaoming

operations.name: parse_japanese_name
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. 山本 早苗 or Yamamoto Sanae

operations.name: japanese_kanji_candidates
operations.description: Identify japanese name candidates in KANJI, based on the romanized name ex. Yamamoto Sanae

operations.name: japanese_latin_candidates
operations.description: Romanize japanese name, based on the name in Kanji.

operations.name: match_japanese_name
operations.description: Return a score for matching Japanese name in KANJI ex. 山本 早苗 with a romanized name ex. Yamamoto Sanae

operations.name: parse_names_batch
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. John Smith or SMITH, John or SMITH; John.

operations.name: parse_names_geo_batch
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. John Smith or SMITH, John or SMITH; John. Giving a local context improves precision.

operations.name: parse_chinese_names_batch
operations.description: Infer the likely first/last name structure of a name, ex. 王晓明 -> 王(surname) 晓明(given name).

operations.name: romanize_chinese_names_batch

operations.name: parse_japanese_names_batch

operations.name: classify_gender_full_batch
